scripts.//build: ALL build/generate steps are LOCAL-ONLY. Never run on the production server (cPanel LVE kills Prisma CLI's Wasm validation with an OOM).
scripts.//local-db: Development DB (Docker/local MariaDB) — destructive, local machine only.
scripts.//remote-db: Remote cPanel DB (via scripts/remote-prisma.js) — safe operations only: deploy/status/seed run from the LOCAL machine against the remote DATABASE_URL.
scripts.//: DELIBERATELY ABSENT: postinstall/preinstall/prestart/prepare hooks. The old "postinstall": "prisma generate" made cPanel's NPM Install invoke the Prisma CLI (Wasm schema validation) server-side and crash under the 4GB LVE. The generated client is shipped pre-built in src/generated/prisma; see DEPLOY_CPANEL.md. prisma + @prisma/client are devDependencies ONLY (needed for local generate; never installed on the server via npm ci --omit=dev).
